text: Sorry to bother you this late, I'm on my own with my daughter tonight and I'm a bit scared if I'm honest. She's 4. About an hour ago she woke up crying and she keeps grabbing at her left ear and telling me it hurts, 'daddy my ear hurts', over and over. She's done the pulling thing on and off since teatime but I thought she was just fiddling. Now she won't let me near it. I keep reading things online and working myself up, and I know kids can have fits when they're poorly, so I've been watching her like a hawk. There's been nothing like that, no shaking or jerking or anything, she's just upset and holding her ear. I don't know if I should be taking her somewhere now or waiting till morning for the GP. My wife normally deals with this stuff and she's away. I just want to know I'm not missing something. She's sitting on my lap now sniffling.
